text: Entry Requirements 1. International students with high school diploma or above and over 18 years old; 2. Non-Chinese citizens holding foreign passports. Good health, good conduct, abide by the laws and regulations of China and the rules and regulations of Chongqing University of Education, abide by social morality and respect local customs; 3. HSK4. Note: Students whose Chinese level has not reached HSK4 can study Chinese in our university for one year, and they can enter the undergraduate stage only after their Chinese level meets the requirements.
